title: 3P Instruments
content: 3P Instruments is a German supplier of gas sorption and particle characterization systems for porous materials research and industrial quality control. Its product range includes BET surface area and pore size analyzers that are directly relevant to aerogel development, benchmarking, and laboratory testing. The company serves users who need detailed characterization of adsorption behavior, porosity, and microstructure in high-performance insulation materials.
